"};
let natureBuffers={}, naturePromise=null, natureSource=null, natureGain=null, natureTimer=0, natureToken=0, natureIdx=0;
const naturePlaylist=['stream','rain','stream','forest','stream','ocean','rain','stream'];
function getNatureBuffers(){
  if(naturePromise)return naturePromise;
  const a=getAudio();if(!a)return Promise.reject(new Error('No Web Audio support'));
  naturePromise=Promise.all(Object.entries(AMBIENT_AUDIO).map(async ([name,b64])=>{
    const binary=atob(b64), bytes=new Uint8Array(binary.length);
    for(let i=0;i<binary.length;i++)bytes[i]=binary.charCodeAt(i);
    natureBuffers[name]=await a.decodeAudioData(bytes.buffer);
  })).catch(err=>{console.warn('Unable to decode nature tracks',err);naturePromise=null;return null});
  return naturePromise;
}
function canMusicPlay(){return state.music&&!document.hidden&&!state.paused&&!$('game').classList.contains('hidden')}
function ambientGainTarget(){return .18*Math.pow(state.ambienceVolume/100,1.35)}
function fadeNature(){
  const a=audio,source=natureSource,g=natureGain;natureSource=null;natureGain=null;
  if(!a||!source||!g)return;
  const now=a.currentTime;
  g.gain.cancelScheduledValues(now);g.gain.setValueAtTime(g.gain.value,now);
  g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0,now+.6);
  try{source.stop(now+.7)}catch{}
}
async function playNature(track,forcePreview=false){
  const token=++natureToken;
  const ready=await getNatureBuffers();
  if(!ready||token!==natureToken)return;
  if(!forcePreview&&!canMusicPlay())return;
  if(!state.music)return;
  const buffer=natureBuffers[track];if(!buffer)return;
  const a=getAudio(),now=a.currentTime;
  const old=natureSource, oldG=natureGain;
  const src=a.createBufferSource(),g=a.createGain();src.buffer=buffer;src.loop=true;
  src.connect(g);g.connect(a.destination);
  g.gain.setValueAtTime(0,now);
  g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(ambientGainTarget(),now+(old?2.8:1.5));
  natureSource=src;natureGain=g;src.start();
  if(old&&oldG){oldG.gain.cancelScheduledValues(now);oldG.gain.setValueAtTime(oldG.gain.value,now);oldG.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0,now+2.8);try{old.stop(now+3)}catch{}}
}
function startNature(preview=false){
  if(!state.music)return;
  if(!preview&&!canMusicPlay())return;
  if(natureSource&&!preview)return;
  const chosen=activeAmbientTrack();
  playNature(chosen,preview);

}
function changeNatureSettings(){
  stopMusic();
  if(state.music){
    if(!$('settingsModal').classList.contains('hidden'))startNature(true);
    else startMusic();
  }
  save();updateSettings();
}
function updateAmbientVolume(){
  state.ambienceVolume=+$('ambienceVolume').value;
  $('ambienceValue').textContent=state.ambienceVolume+'%';
  if(natureGain&&audio)natureGain.gain.setTargetAtTime(ambientGainTarget(),audio.currentTime,.08);
  save();
}

function startMusic(){
 if(!canMusicPlay())return;
 getAudio();
 startNature();
}
function stopMusic(){
 clearInterval(natureTimer);natureTimer=0;
 ++natureToken;fadeNature();
}
function setToggle(field){state[field]=!state[field];updateSettings();if(field==='music'){if(state.music)startMusic();else stopMusic()}sfx('collect');save()}

// Pointer capture keeps the release event even if the finger moves outside the board.
// The user can peek behind a covered tile without removing it.
let tileGesture=null;
function finishGesture(e,cancel=false){
  const g=tileGesture;if(!g||e.pointerId!==g.pointerId)return;
  tileGesture=null;
  clearTimeout(g.holdTimer);
  try{if(board.hasPointerCapture(e.pointerId))board.releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId)}catch{}
  const dx=e.clientX-g.x,dy=e.clientY-g.y;
  const dragged=g.dragged||Math.hypot(dx,dy)>10;
  if(dragged){
    if(g.node.isConnected){
      g.node.classList.remove('peek-drag');g.node.classList.add('peek-return');
      g.node.style.transform='translate3d(0,0,0)';
      setTimeout(()=>{if(g.node.isConnected){g.node.style.zIndex='';g.node.style.transform='';g.node.classList.remove('peek-return')}},330);
    }
    return;
  }
  if(!cancel&&!g.held)collect(g.id);
}
board.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{
  if(state.paused||state.busy||tileGesture||e.button!==0)return;
  const n=e.target.closest('.tile[data-id]');if(!n||!board.contains(n))return;
  const t=state.tiles.find(x=>x.id===n.dataset.id);if(!t||t.removed)return;
  tileGesture={pointerId:e.pointerId,id:n.dataset.id,node:n,x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY,dragged:false,held:false,holdTimer:null};
  const gesture=tileGesture;
  if(t.hidden&&!t.revealed&&free(t,state.tiles))gesture.holdTimer=setTimeout(()=>{
    if(tileGesture===gesture&&!gesture.dragged){gesture.held=true;revealHidden(t)}
  },430);
  try{board.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId)}catch{}
  e.preventDefault();
});
board.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{
  const g=tileGesture;if(!g||g.pointerId!==e.pointerId||!g.node.isConnected)return;
  const dx=e.clientX-g.x,dy=e.clientY-g.y;
  if(!g.dragged&&Math.hypot(dx,dy)<11)return;
  clearTimeout(g.holdTimer);g.dragged=true;
  g.node.classList.remove('peek-return');g.node.classList.add('peek-drag');
  const width=g.node.offsetWidth,height=g.node.offsetHeight;
  const x=Math.max(-width*.95,Math.min(width*.95,dx));
  const y=Math.max(-height*.7,Math.min(height*.7,dy));
  g.node.style.zIndex='1500';g.node.style.transform=`translate3d(${x}px,${y}px,0) scale(1.045)`;
  e.preventDefault();
});
board.addEventListener('pointerup',e=>finishGesture(e));
board.addEventListener('pointercancel',e=>finishGesture(e,true));
board.addEventListener('lostpointercapture',e=>{if(tileGesture?.pointerId===e.pointerId)finishGesture(e,true)});
// Some keyboard/accessibility activations synthesize click without pointer input.
board.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.detail!==0)return;const node=e.target.closest('.tile[data-id]');if(node)collect(node.dataset.id)});

$('play').onclick=()=>{getAudio();newGame('classic',true)};$('daily').onclick=()=>{getAudio();newGame('daily')};$('relax').onclick=()=>{getAudio();newGame('zen')};$('mystery').onclick=()=>{getAudio();newGame('mystery')};$('back').onclick=home;$('homeSettings').onclick=()=>modal('settingsModal');$('pause').onclick=()=>modal('settingsModal');$('trayInfo').onclick=()=>modal('helpModal');$('shuffle').onclick=reshuffle;$('hint').onclick=hint;$('undo').onclick=undo;$('magic').onclick=magic;
$('musicToggle').onclick=()=>setToggle('music');$('ambienceSelect').onchange=e=>{state.ambienceMode=e.target.value;changeNatureSettings()};$('worldSelect').onchange=e=>{state.worldMode=e.target.value;applyWorldTheme(true);render();changeNatureSettings();save()};$('ambienceVolume').oninput=updateAmbientVolume;$('sfxToggle').onclick=()=>setToggle('sound');$('vibrateToggle').onclick=()=>setToggle('vibrate');$('themeToggle').onclick=()=>{state.theme=state.theme==='ivory'?'jade':'ivory';updateSettings();render();save()};$('restart').onclick=()=>newGame(state.mode);$('toMenu').onclick=home;
$('fullUndo').onclick=undo;$('fullMagic').onclick=()=>{closeModal();magic()};$('stuckShuffle').onclick=reshuffle;$('stuckUndo').onclick=undo;$('stuckRestart').onclick=()=>newGame(state.mode);$('nextLevel').onclick=()=>newGame(state.mode==='daily'?'classic':state.mode);$('winMenu').onclick=home;
document.querySelectorAll('[data-close]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=closeModal);document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(['Escape','Backspace'].includes(e.key)){e.preventDefault();let open=allModals.find(x=>!$(x).classList.contains('hidden'));if(open)closeModal();else if(!$('game').classList.contains('hidden'))modal('settingsModal')}});
window.addEventListener('resize',()=>{resizeVfx();if(!$('game').classList.contains('hidden'))drawBoard()});document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(document.hidden)stopMusic();else if(state.music&&!state.paused)startMusic()});
resizeVfx();raf=requestAnimationFrame(effects);$('play').innerHTML=`▶ &nbsp; PLAY LEVEL ${state.level}`;applyWorldTheme(false);updateSettings();
window.emeraldTest={state,generate,positions,free,newGame,collect,revealHidden,returnStored,findPair,undo,reshuffle,magic,hint,snapshot,drawBoard,applyMystery,applyWorldTheme,resolveWorldId,getNatureBuffers,audioStatus:()=>({mode:state.ambienceMode,naturePlaying:!!natureSource,natureDecoded:Object.keys(natureBuffers).length})};
})();
</script></body></html>
